conditional_verdict: Accept nuisance projection, design-defect optimum identity, information-normalized precision and query bounds under stated finite unconstrained quadratic premises. Repetition subsection needs a prior-free premise before entire packet acceptance.

findings.finding: Packet permits unchanged Gaussian prior rows included once, then claims repeated designs multiply both full objectives by N and divide covariance by N. With a once-only nonzero prior this claim is false.
findings.counterexample: Scalar data L_N(b)=N*b^2/2 and approximate data N*(b+1)^2/2, with unchanged once-only prior b^2/2. Baseline optimum is 0, approximate optimum is -N/(N+1), precision N+1. Displacement changes with N; covariance 1/(N+1) differs from original covariance divided by N. All finite/full-rank assumptions hold.
findings.requested_change: Explicitly limit exact N and sqrt(N) scaling to prior-free repeated-design objectives, and state that an unchanged once-only prior changes those exact formulas; alternatively derive retained-prior expressions. Preserve fresh-observation and no-double-counting caveats.
findings.disposition: Author notified; revision and independent re-review required.

accepted_reasoning: M is an orthogonal projector even for rank-deficient nuisance Z; S SPD identifies target optimum; nuisance optimum need not be unique. Consistent prior augmentation preserves this result.
At baseline optimum A^T r=0, expansion of B^T(r+d) gives A^T d+D^T r+D^T d. Full-rank B gives exact quadratic displacement.

Q has orthonormal columns; reverse triangle inequality bounds singular values of Q+G. Congruence gives Loewner bounds; SPD inversion and Cauchy-Schwarz yield formal query variance and displacement bounds.
Unresolved ranks, nonlinear remainder, support constraints, formal precision versus physical coverage, and source ownership are correctly separated.
The H3 moment projection is the fixed-nuisance two-column special case; joint nuisance adjustment correctly replaces raw target columns by projected ones.

import numpy as np, json
from fractions import Fraction
rng=np.random.default_rng(29171)
X=np.array([[1.,0],[1,1],[1,2],[1,3],[1,4]])
Z=np.array([[1.,2],[0,0],[1,2],[0,0],[1,2]])
y=np.array([1.,-1,2,0,4]); e=np.array([.2,-.1,.3,.4,-.2])
M=np.eye(5)-Z@np.linalg.pinv(Z); S=X.T@M@X
joint=np.column_stack((X,Z))
p=np.linalg.lstsq(joint,y,rcond=None)[0][:2]
ph=np.linalg.lstsq(joint,y-e,rcond=None)[0][:2]
projection_error=float(np.max(np.abs(ph-p+np.linalg.solve(S,X.T@M@e))))
assert projection_error<1e-12
naive=-np.linalg.solve(X.T@X,X.T@e)
projected=-np.linalg.solve(S,X.T@M@e)
assert np.linalg.norm(naive-projected)>.01
max_identity=0.; min_slack=float('inf')
for _ in range(100):
 A=rng.normal(size=(9,4)); y=rng.normal(size=9)
 P=A.T@A; w,V=np.linalg.eigh(P); root=(V*np.sqrt(w))@V.T; invroot=(V/w**.5)@V.T
 D=rng.normal(size=A.shape); D*=.4/np.linalg.norm(D@invroot,2)
 B=A+D; e0=rng.normal(size=9)*.2
 b=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]; bh=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y-e0,rcond=None)[0]
 r=A@b-y; d=D@b+e0; dg=A.T@d+D.T@r+D.T@d
 err=np.linalg.norm(bh-b+np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,dg)); max_identity=max(max_identity,float(err)); assert err<1e-12
 eps=np.linalg.norm(D@invroot,2); C=invroot@B.T@B@invroot
 ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh(C)
 slacks=[ev.min()-(1-eps)**2,(1+eps)**2-ev.max()]
 j=rng.normal(size=4); v=j@np.linalg.solve(P,j); vh=j@np.linalg.solve(B.T@B,j)
 slacks += [vh-v/(1+eps)**2,v/(1-eps)**2-vh]
 bound=np.linalg.norm(invroot@dg)/(1-eps)**2
 slacks += [bound-np.linalg.norm(root@(bh-b)),np.sqrt(v)*bound-abs(j@(bh-b))]
 min_slack=min(min_slack,*[float(s) for s in slacks]); assert min(slacks)>-1e-12
A=np.array([[1.],[0.] ]); y=np.array([0.,1.]); D=np.array([[0.],[.5]])
b=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]; bh=np.linalg.lstsq(A+D,y,rcond=None)[0]
assert b[0]==0 and abs(bh[0]-.4)<1e-14
weakA=np.diag([1.,1e-8]); weakD=np.diag([0.,9e-9]); eps=np.linalg.norm(weakD@np.diag([1.,1e8]),2)
assert abs(eps-.9)<1e-14
prior=[]
for N in (1,2,10):
 # Data .5*N*b^2, response defect +1; unchanged prior .5*b^2.
 prior.append({'N':N,'baseline_b':0,'approx_b':str(Fraction(-N,N+1)),'covariance':str(Fraction(1,N+1))})
print(json.dumps({'nuisance_rank_deficient_Z_projection_error':projection_error,'naive_shift':naive.tolist(),'projected_shift':projected.tolist(),'random_design_cases':100,'max_exact_displacement_error':max_identity,'min_normalized_bound_slack':min_slack,'value_agreement_nonzero_residual_shift':float(bh[0]),'weak_absolute_defect':9e-9,'weak_normalized_epsilon':eps,'once_only_prior_counterexample':prior},indent=2))
